description:
**Project Role :** Data Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.
  

**Must have skills :** Data Engineering  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Data Engineer, a typical day involves developing and migrating complex data\-driven insights and knowledge engine interfaces that support organizational decision\-making processes. The role includes deploying and maintaining these systems to ensure continuous availability and reliability. A significant part of the day is dedicated to integrating robust security measures and data privacy protections to safeguard sensitive information. Collaboration with various teams to align technical solutions with business needs is also a key aspect, ensuring that the insights generated are actionable and support strategic goals effectively.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Lead design and development of complex PLX\-based dashboards, workflows, data processes, analytical tools, and automation solutions.
* Translate functional and analytical requirements into scalable technical designs and implementation plans.
* Develop advanced SQL logic for large datasets, including transformation, validation, optimization, metric calculation, and exception handling.
* Build or guide Python\-based automation, data validation, analytical processing, and repeatable workflows in Colab.
* Review code, SQL, dashboards, workflows, documentation, and test outputs produced by developers and entry\-level developers.
* Provide technical direction on solution design, data model usage, workflow structure, performance, maintainability, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with techno\-functional analysts, managers, consultants, and stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve ambiguity.
* Identify reusable components, development standards, and opportunities to improve delivery efficiency.
* Support production issue resolution, root\-cause analysis, defect fixes, and enhancement prioritization.
* Mentor junior developers and help build technical capability across the team.

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Oracle Procedural Language Extensions to SQL (PLSQL).
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, performance\-aware query design, data transformation, and validation logic.
* Strong experience building analytics, BI, dashboard, workflow, or automation solutions on large datasets.
* Strong Python capability for analysis, automation, validation, and reusable processing logic.
* Ability to work within or quickly adapt to PLX and Google internal analytics platforms.
* Practical understanding of data modeling, reporting architecture, ETL/ELT concepts, workflows, and BI delivery.
* Good understanding of business analytics and ability to align technical design with stakeholder outcomes.
* Ability to guide developers, review outputs, enforce quality, and troubleshoot complex issues.
* Exposure to BigQuery, Looker, Vertex, or GCP tools is useful but secondary to PLX\-first delivery capability.
* Strong documentation, communication, and technical leadership skills.

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in analytics solution development, SQL development, BI engineering, reporting automation, or related roles.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

description:
**Project Role :** Technology Support Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Resolve incidents and problems across multiple business system components and ensure operational stability. Create and implement Requests for Change (RFC) and update knowledge base articles to support effective troubleshooting. Collaborate with vendors and help service management teams with issue analysis and resolution.
  

**Must have skills :** Network Infrastructures  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Job Summary:  

The Level 2 Enterprise Network Operations Center (NOC) Engineer plays a critical role in the continuous monitoring, management, and maintenance of the company's enterprise network infrastructure. This position involves handling more complex network issues, providing advanced technical support, and ensuring high network performance and reliability. The Level 2 NOC Engineer collaborates closely with Level 1\.5 \& 2 support, network engineers, and other IT teams to maintain optimal network operations.  

Key Responsibilities:  

Continuously monitor network performance and health using advanced network management tools.  

Analyze network alerts and incidents, identifying potential issues before they impact operations.  

Troubleshoot and resolve escalated network issues, including hardware, software, and connectivity problems.  

Provide advanced technical support for complex network incidents, ensuring timely resolution.  

Perform scheduled maintenance activities, including firmware upgrades, patching, and configuration changes.  

Maintaining network infrastructure consisting of network devices such as Cisco routers/switches, Cisco Wireless, Extreme Wireless, F5 Load Balancers, Cisco ACI, VMware AVI, CradlePoint Routers, Packet capturing tools, Cisco ISE, Infoblox, Cisco SD\-WAN, NetGate, Microsemi Time Server.  

Analyze network performance data to identify and implement optimization opportunities.  

Maintain detailed records of network incidents, changes, and maintenance activities.  

Generate comprehensive reports on network performance, incidents, and resolutions for management.  

Work closely with Level 1\.5 support to provide guidance and assistance in resolving network issues.  

Escalate unresolved or critical issues to Level 3 support or network engineers as necessary.  

Provide training and mentorship to Level 1\.5 NOC staff to enhance their technical skills and knowledge.  

Share best practices and promote a culture of continuous improvement within the NOC team.  

Stay current with emerging network technologies and industry trends.  

Participate in professional development activities to enhance technical expertise.  

Identify automation scope within project deliverables.  

  

Must Have Skills/Qualifications:  

Educational Qualifications: BE, BTech.  

Technology Certifications: CCNA/CCNP (must have), CCDP (good to have), CCIE (good to have)
  

Proven experience in a network operations center or a similar network support role.  

Strong knowledge of network protocols, hardware, and software.  

Proficiency with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SNOW, Infoblox, Netbrain, PRTG).  

Strong understanding of networking concepts, including routing, switching, Wireless LANs, VPNs, and firewalls.  

Experience with network troubleshooting and incident management.  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.  

Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.  

Good understanding of the emerging network technology trends


  

15 years full time education

description:
**Description**
 As part of the Last Mile Science \& Technology organization, you’ll partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to drive improvements in Amazon's Last Mile delivery network. You will leverage data and analytics to generate insights that accelerate the scale, efficiency, and quality of the routes we build for our drivers through our end\-to\-end last mile planning systems. You will develop complex data engineering solutions using AWS technology stack (S3, Glue, IAM, Redshift, Athena). You should have deep expertise and passion in working with large data sets, building complex data processes, performance tuning, bringing data from disparate data stores and programmatically identifying patterns. You will work with business owners to develop and define key business questions and requirements. You will provide guidance and support for other engineers with industry best practices and direction. Analytical ingenuity and leadership, business acumen, effective communication capabilities, and the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment are critical skills for this role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, implement, and support data warehouse / data lake infrastructure using AWS big data stack, Python, Redshift, Quicksight, Glue/lake formation, EMR/Spark/Scala, Athena etc.
* Extract huge volumes of structured and unstructured data from various sources (Relational /Non\-relational/No\-SQL database) and message streams and construct complex analyses.
* Develop and manage ETLs to source data from various systems and create unified data model for analytics and reporting
* Perform detailed source\-system analysis, source\-to\-target data analysis, and transformation analysis
* Participate in the full development cycle for ETL: design, implementation, validation, documentation, and maintenance.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of data engineering experience
* 4\+ years of SQL experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non\-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key\-value stores, graph databases, column\-family databases)
* Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS

description:
**Description**
 Interested in the gig economy? Come be a part of it. The Amazon Flex Analytics Team is building the global business intelligence platform that powers Amazon Flex worldwide. We’re working hard, having fun, and making history!
   

  

 We are looking for candidates who want to help shape the future of Flex. Specifically, we are looking for a Data Engineer who is passionate about data architecture and wants help us use data to understand Flex Driver behavior and satisfaction. In this role, you will develop and support the analytic technologies that give our teams flexible and structured access to their data, including implementation of a BI platform, defining metrics and KPIs, and automating reporting and data visualization.
   

  

 The successful candidate considers themselves an enterprise data architect. You should excel in the design, creation, and management of analytical data infrastructure. You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable processes to publish data and build solutions to reconcile data for integrity and accuracy of data sets used for analysis and reporting. You should have broad understanding of RDBMS, ETL, Data Integration, Data Warehousing, Data Governance and Data Lakes. Experience with Python, R, or Spark is highly preferred and will put you at the top of the list.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to use your skills in the following areas:
   

  

* Create and support data pipelines built on Amazon and AWS technologies including Spark, Cradle, DataCraft, Glue, Kinesis, and Redshift/Spectrum
* Develop and improve the current data architecture, data quality, monitoring and data availability
* Collaborate with BI Engineers to continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, simplifying self\-service support for customers
* Design, implement, and support platforms that provide business teams ad\-hoc access to large datasets (ex. data visualization tools for non\-tech business users)
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions that drive the DE team’s work

* 3\+ years of data engineering experience
